description: Department of Local Government North Central Province - Electing the Vice Chairman for the Rebewa Pradeshiya Sabha of Anuradhapura District in North Central Province meeting will be held Conference Hall of Rabewa Pradeshiya Sabha at 10.00 am on 22.08.2022
reasoning: This gazette notice announces a meeting for the election of a vice chairman for a local authority (Rabewa Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes at the local government level, including the scheduling of an election meeting, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
